answer_1.quote: We fine-tune the continuously pre-trained BART-base on the Closed-book QA task. The metrics are EM(Exact Match) and F1 from . Table  shows the comparison results of different strategies. Closed-book QA is more difficult than cloze-style QA since the models need to generate answers without any extra hints, e.g., the answer length is indicated by the number of [MASK]s in the clozestyle QA, while the models need to predict the answer length in closed-book QA.
